Package neqsim.process.equipment.separator

Class SeparatorCapacityAssessment

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.separator.SeparatorCapacityAssessment
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class SeparatorCapacityAssessment extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable evidence snapshot for a separator Souders-Brown gas-capacity assessment.

The snapshot is detached from the separator and fails closed when geometry, thermodynamic state, design K-factor, or design-basis provenance is unavailable. It does not size equipment or approve operation.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim Development Team

  • Constructor Details

    • SeparatorCapacityAssessment

      private SeparatorCapacityAssessment(String separatorName, SeparatorCapacityAssessment.Status status, String diagnostic, String designBasisProvenance, String designBasisSource, double designBasisConfidence, String governingCapacityBasis, String orientation, double internalDiameterM, double designLiquidLevelFraction, double gasAreaM2, double gasDensityKgM3, double liquidDensityKgM3, double designGasLoadFactorMPerS, double maximumGasVelocityMPerS, double currentGasFlowM3PerS, double mechanicalDesignMaximumGasFlowM3PerS, double soudersBrownMaximumGasFlowM3PerS, double maximumGasFlowM3PerS, double utilization)
      Creates an immutable snapshot.
      Parameters:
      separatorName - separator name
      status - assessment status
      diagnostic - status explanation
      designBasisProvenance - source of the design capacity basis
      designBasisSource - NeqSim object that supplied the governing design limit
      designBasisConfidence - confidence assigned to the governing design constraint
      governingCapacityBasis - name of the governing capacity calculation
      orientation - separator orientation
      internalDiameterM - internal diameter in metres
      designLiquidLevelFraction - design liquid level fraction
      gasAreaM2 - available gas flow area in square metres
      gasDensityKgM3 - gas density in kilograms per cubic metre
      liquidDensityKgM3 - liquid density in kilograms per cubic metre
      designGasLoadFactorMPerS - design K-factor in metres per second
      maximumGasVelocityMPerS - maximum Souders-Brown gas velocity in metres per second
      currentGasFlowM3PerS - current gas volumetric flow in cubic metres per second
      mechanicalDesignMaximumGasFlowM3PerS - mechanical-design gas limit in cubic metres per second
      soudersBrownMaximumGasFlowM3PerS - Souders-Brown gas limit in cubic metres per second
      maximumGasFlowM3PerS - maximum gas volumetric flow in cubic metres per second
      utilization - current flow divided by maximum flow
